If all six are equal, each must be 360° ÷ 6 = 60° — which is acute, not reflex.  
A reflex angle can’t be equal to the others if all six are to sum to 360° — because even one reflex angle (>180°) would force the rest to be too small to match it.

So:  
✅ All six equal → each is 60° → no reflex angles.  
❌ One reflex angle → the others can’t be equal to it.
